description: Defines the 'Cashier' entity class for the Fineract project, representing a row in the 'm_cashiers' database table with methods for JSON-based creation and updates, including time parsing and change tracking.

classes.name: Cashier
classes.description: Entity class representing a cashier with properties for office, staff, teller, description, start/end dates and times, including methods for JSON creation and updates.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Cashier instance from JSON command and related entities, extracting description, start/end dates, and full-day flag.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the Cashier instance based on JSON command, tracking changes in description, dates, full-day flag, and times.

methods.name: getHourFromStartTime
methods.description: Parses and returns the hour component from startTime string.

methods.name: getMinFromStartTime
methods.description: Parses and returns the minute component from startTime string.

methods.name: getHourFromEndTime
methods.description: Parses and returns the hour component from endTime string.

methods.name: getMinFromEndTime
methods.description: Parses and returns the minute component from endTime string.
